The degree-four P has derivative strictly positive on [0,1], with \(P(0)<0<P(1)\), proving one and only one positive cancellation bias with an actual sign reversal. Exact opposite rational witnesses at \(d=1/2\) and \(d=99/100\) and finite-state Markov continuity establish a nonempty open set of nearby rates with a finite cancellation. The physical factor 1/2 in hop rates was checked. verifier exact run: VERIFY_OK. Unproved: uniqueness for perturbed rates and statements for longer chains.

value.rationale: A four-site open chain is the minimal configuration with two independently tunable bulk waiting times and reflection-asymmetric equilibrium profile under identical contacts. The source highlights possible cancellation as a substantive outstanding transport mechanism; exact rational currents prove not just isolated equality but one unique finite root with reversal of preferred transport direction. Strict rational witnesses and continuity show the phenomenon is not confined to a single fine-tuned rate vector. The result has a plausible role as a benchmark for nonlinear rectification beyond truncated mean field. No general theorem or long-chain claim is asserted.
